lessons.title: 15. Business Analytics & Reporting
lessons.description: Write a report joining customers, orders, and products to find total spending per customer.
lessons.starter_code: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
